title: Shifting Perspectives: Steering Vectors for Robust Bias Mitigation in LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured stereotypical bias in religious contexts across three different tasks: question answering (BBQ), sentence completion/likelihood (StereoSet), and adversarial robustness against jailbreak prompts (CLEAR-Bias).
findings: The performance of steering vectors for mitigating religious bias was mixed. They were the most effective method on the adversarial CLEAR-Bias dataset. However, they underperformed other methods like fine-tuning on the BBQ dataset and performed worse than the baseline model on the StereoSet dataset, indicating they increased stereotypical associations in that context.
